name: Arithmetic software fixture (not a research benchmark)
provenance: Project-authored exact-integer checks. Answers independently recomputed with Python math; definitions checked against Python official documentation on 2026-10-19. verified refers only to these ground-truth answers, not representativeness or model performance.

questions.question: What is 5 factorial? Return only the integer.
What is the greatest common divisor of 18 and 24? Return only the integer.
How many ways can 2 items be chosen from 5 without repetition and without regard to order? Return only the integer.
What is the integer square root of 81? Return only the integer.
